Johnny Valdes Jazz Trio

Johnny Valdes is a guitarist, composer, and singer from Modesto, CA. He has been playing professionally for more than two decades and is currently signed to the Rhythmus record label started by legendary musician/producer Ray Obiedo. His influences include Wes Montgomery, Bill Evans, Jimi Hendrix, Pat Martino, John Coltrane, and Charlie Parker. He’s recorded with Jazz legend John Stowell and has also performed with Barry Finnerty (Miles Davis), and David K. Matthews (Santana). Johnny has also performed with Mic Gillette and Marc van Wageningen (Tower of Power). He’s currently preparing for the release of his debut album.

event.description:
After Dark was born from a wandering mind and too many questions to keep to itself.

Created by Briane Gadson, After Dark is a creative platform for live conversations and cultural experiences exploring curiosity, psychology, art, desire, identity, culture, and the strange, beautiful things that make us human.

Through thoughtful conversation, immersive details, and unexpected questions, After Dark invites people to look beneath the obvious, challenge what they think they know, and experience something a little differently.

Come curious. Leave feeling more alive.

event.description:
Juiced and Fit Kitchen Meal Prep are locally owned businesses dedicated to making healthy living both convenient and enjoyable. Located in downtown Modesto, Juiced offers fresh, cold-pressed juices made from raw, unpasteurized produce, with a rotating seasonal menu that keeps wellness exciting and flavorful. Founded in 2020 by Erika and Mike, Fit Kitchen Meal Prep was created to help busy individuals enjoy nutritious, great-tasting meals without the stress of planning and cooking. Erika brings a passion for fitness, nutrition, and helping others stay consistent with their goals, while Mike develops balanced, flavorful meals that prove healthy eating doesn’t have to be boring. Together, they share a commitment to quality, convenience, sustainability, and community.

 

Join us for a special dinner experience featuring a delicious sampling of Fit Kitchen’s signature meals, perfectly paired with fresh juices from Juiced. Your ticket includes dinner, your choice of a glass of wine or fresh juice, tax, and gratuity.

Doors open at 5; Dinner at 5:30 p.m.

To me, music is a universal language that brings hearts together and spiritual healing through the supernatural.

event.title: Extraordinary Foods
event.description:
Extraordinary Foods was born in 2022 in Modesto, California, from a simple idea: ordinary food is easy to find—Extraordinary food is something you have to create.

Founded by Garret Bianco, Extraordinary Foods is a grassroots craft food company built around bold flavors, creativity, and a hands-on approach to making food from the ground up. What started with a passion for growing peppers and experimenting with hot sauce has grown into a unique food brand focused on sauces, condiments, fermented products, and custom food creations.

Garret began growing peppers in 2020, with a particular fascination for rare and exceptionally hot varieties. As his freezer began filling with peppers, he started turning them into hot sauces, experimenting with different combinations of heat, acidity, sweetness, smoke, fruit, and savory ingredients. The goal wasn’t simply to make something hot—it was to find the perfect balance in every bottle.

That philosophy became the foundation of Extraordinary Foods.

Based in the heart of California’s Central Valley, Garret draws heavily from the ingredients, agriculture, and character of the region. His creations incorporate locally inspired ingredients such as California figs, white grapes, Fresno and Anaheim peppers, Stanislaus tomatoes, Gilroy garlic, olive oil, and other California-grown products.

One of the company’s signature creations, California Figment, represents that philosophy. Developed over two years, the Central Valley-style BBQ sauce combines California white grapes and black Mission figs with peppers, garlic, tomatoes, vinegar, and savory ingredients to create a BBQ sauce that is distinctly Californian and anything but ordinary.

Extraordinary Foods has also expanded beyond its own product line into custom formulation and white-label production, helping other food businesses develop unique sauces and specialty products. One of the company’s most significant projects has been a custom Sciabica Charcuterie Sauce, created in partnership with the Sciabica family and their California olive oil company.

Garret’s work has also received attention beyond the local food community. Extraordinary Foods was featured on Good Day Sacramento, where Garret showcased California Figment and his craft sauce creations, putting a spotlight on the growing specialty-food scene in Modesto and the Central Valley.

At its core, Extraordinary Foods remains intentionally personal. It isn’t about becoming another mass-produced sauce company. It’s about craftsmanship, experimentation, local connections, and putting the creator’s time and passion into every product.

From rare peppers and fermentation to BBQ sauce, hot sauce, mustard, michelada mix, ponzu, and custom formulations, Extraordinary Foods is built on one belief:

Don’t make ordinary food. Make something Extraordinary.

Doors at 5; Food at 5:30 p.m.
